summary: Creates transformed copies of source SOP geometry, optionally copying to template points and transferring or modifying attributes per copy.

key_params.name: templategrp
key_params.note: Template point group for copy placement.

key_params.name: nml
key_params.note: Transform copies according to template normals.

key_params.name: vlength
key_params.note: Maintain vector length when using normals.

key_params.name: stamp
key_params.note: Enable stamping to vary upstream parameters.

key_params.name: copy
key_params.note: Current copy number local variable context.

key_params.name: doattr
key_params.note: Enable attribute operations from template points.

common_gotchas: Stamping cooks upstream geometry separately per copy and can become expensive quickly.
Input order matters: source geometry is copied to template points from the second input when present.
Use a template `up` attribute when normal-driven orientation twists unpredictably.
key_concepts: Copy SOP creates repeated transformed copies of source geometry, either by count or onto template points from the second input.
Template point normals and `up` attributes can drive per-copy orientation and stabilize normal-based alignment.
Stamping evaluates upstream parameters separately per copy, enabling variation at a potentially high cook cost.
Template point attributes can set, multiply, add, or subtract point, primitive, and vertex attributes on copied geometry.
